beats.note: Encryption is also important in online banking and electronic payments.
Financial institutions use cryptographic protocols to protect account information, verify transactions, and reduce the risk of unauthorized access.
Virtual private networks, or VPNs, use encryption to protect data traveling between a device and a VPN server.
This can help prevent people on the same network from easily viewing the user’s traffic.
Businesses and governments use encryption to protect confidential records, intellectual property, medical data, and classified information.
In these environments, encryption is often combined with access controls, authentication, monitoring, and other security measures.
